title: Immediate radial linked-panel tracking
context: User feedback supersedes the timed nearest-edge motion and exact pink ratios in feat-linked-panel-hover. Project from the center through the pointer so each diagonal arm reaches its corner immediately.

tasks.title: Replace eased tracking with immediate radial projection
acceptance_criteria: Both ellipses update synchronously with pointer movement without positional easing or an animation loop.

Normalized radial projection maps every point on each diagonal arm to its corresponding corner; between arms movement remains on an edge. Exact center retains the last position, defaulting to top-left.
Pink ::before is 54% wide and 76% tall, with left = x * 46% and top = 5% + y * 14%; amber remains 32px square.
Existing surface/fade transitions, keyboard and reduced-motion static feedback, native links, touch behavior and resize/scroll handling remain functional.
Browser regression tests cover immediate updates, diagonal arm samples, center handling and responsive geometry; npm run verify passes and independent evaluator returns PASS.
